question: What shines in the dark sky at night? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! The moon glows brightly in the dark night sky! 🌙
hint: It is big and white and comes out when it gets dark.

question: What are the tiny twinkling lights in the sky? ✨
explanation: Great job! Stars twinkle beautifully far away in the night sky! ✨
hint: We sing 'Twinkle Twinkle Little...' to them.

question: What color is the sky at night? 🌌
explanation: Super! When the sun sets, the sky turns very dark and black! ⚫
hint: It is the darkest color.

question: What do we do when it is night time? 🛏️
explanation: Awesome! We rest our bodies and go to sleep at night! 💤
hint: We close our eyes and rest.

question: Where do we go to sleep? 🛌
explanation: Great! We sleep safely and comfortably in our warm beds! 🛏️
hint: It has a soft mattress.

question: What do we wear when we go to bed? 👕
explanation: Super! Soft pajamas keep us cozy while we sleep! 👕
hint: They are special clothes for sleeping.

question: Which bird stays awake at night? 🦉
explanation: Awesome! Owls have big eyes to see in the dark at night! 🦉
hint: This bird has big round eyes.

question: What sound does an owl make in the night? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Owls make a soft hooting sound in the quiet night! 🦉
hint: It sounds like 'Hoo Hoo'.

question: Which little bug glows in the dark? 🪲
explanation: Super! Fireflies have tiny lights that glow beautifully at night! ✨
hint: It has the word 'fire' in its name.

question: How does the house feel at night? 🤫
explanation: Awesome! Everything becomes peaceful and very quiet at night! 🤫
hint: There is no loud noise.

question: What must we do before sleeping? 🪥
explanation: Great! Brushing our teeth keeps them clean and healthy while we sleep! 🪥
hint: We use paste and a brush.

question: What do we rest our head on in bed? 🛌
explanation: Super! A soft pillow helps our head rest comfortably all night! ☁️
hint: It is very squishy and soft.

question: What keeps us warm in bed? 🥶
explanation: Awesome! A thick, cozy blanket keeps us nice and warm! 🛌
hint: We pull it over our bodies to stay warm.

question: What do we see in our mind when we sleep? 💭
explanation: Great job! Our mind shows us sweet dreams while we rest! 💭
hint: They are like little movies in our sleep.

question: What do we like to hear before falling asleep? 📖
explanation: Super! Bedtime stories are fun and help us fall asleep happily! 📖
hint: Mom or Dad reads this from a book.

question: What happens to the sun when night comes? 🌇
explanation: Awesome! The sun sets in the evening to make way for the night! 🌇
hint: It hides away below the sky.

question: When the sun goes away, the sky gets... 🌘
explanation: Great! The sky gets very dark because there is no sunlight! 🌌
hint: You cannot see well without a light.

question: What wakes us up from our sleep in the morning? 🌅
explanation: Super! The bright sun rises to start a brand new day! ☀️
hint: It is yellow and very bright.

question: What do the stars do high up in the sky? 🌟
explanation: Awesome! Stars twinkle and sparkle beautifully in the dark! ✨
hint: They flash their little lights.

question: Which shape looks like a half moon? 🌙
explanation: Great job! Sometimes the moon is curved just like a yellow banana! 🌙
hint: It is a curved yellow fruit.

question: Which animal flies around at night? 🦇
explanation: Super! Bats fly in the dark night sky to find their food! 🦇
hint: It has wings and hangs upside down.

question: What tiny bugs make a chirping sound at night? 🦗
explanation: Awesome! Crickets sing special songs by chirping at night! 🦗
hint: They hop and make a 'chirp chirp' sound.

question: How do we feel when bedtime comes? 🥱
explanation: Great! Our bodies feel sleepy because they need rest! 🥱
hint: We start to yawn.

question: What do we turn off before we go to sleep? 💡
explanation: Super! We turn off the lights to make the room dark for sleeping! 💡
hint: They make the room bright.

question: What nice words do we say before sleeping? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! Saying 'Good night' is a sweet way to end the day! 🌙
hint: We say this right before bed.

question: What covers the moon and stars sometimes? ☁️
explanation: Great job! Clouds float in the sky and sometimes hide the moon! ☁️
hint: They are fluffy and hold rain.

question: Where do birds go to sleep at night? 🐦
explanation: Super! Birds rest safely in their cozy nests built in trees! 🪹
hint: It is a home made of twigs.

question: What do our pet dogs do at night? 🐕
explanation: Awesome! Just like us, our pets also need to sleep quietly! 🐕
hint: They close their eyes and rest.

question: Why is sleeping at night good for us? 🤔
explanation: Great! Sleeping helps our body grow and rest well for the next day! 🌟
hint: It gives us energy for tomorrow.

question: What warm drink helps us sleep well? 🥛
explanation: Super! Drinking warm milk makes our tummy happy and helps us sleep! 🥛
hint: It is white and comes from a cow.

question: What small light keeps the room from being too dark? 🔦
explanation: Awesome! A little nightlight gives a soft glow to help us see! 💡
hint: We plug it into the wall.

question: Which pet animal loves to walk around at night? 🐈
explanation: Great job! Cats can see very well in the dark and love to explore! 🐈
hint: It says 'Meow'.

question: What do some pretty flowers do when it gets dark? 🌷
explanation: Super! Some flowers fold their petals and go to sleep too! 🌷
hint: They fold their petals.

question: Where does the sun hide at night? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! The Earth spins, so the sun shines on the other side of the world! 🌍
hint: It goes around the Earth.

question: What shape is the moon when it is completely full? 🌕
explanation: Great! A full moon looks just like a big, bright circle in the sky! 🌕
hint: It is round like a ball.

question: What do we close when it is time to sleep? 👀
explanation: Super! Closing our eyes helps us drift off into sweet dreams! 👀
hint: We use them to see.

question: What is the best thing to hug while sleeping? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! A soft teddy bear is perfect for hugging at night! 🧸
hint: It is a soft and fluffy toy animal.

question: How does the air feel during the night? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! Without the hot sun, the night air feels nice and cool! 🌬️
hint: You might need a blanket.

question: What should we do if we wake up thirsty at night? 💧
explanation: Super! Drinking plain water is the best way to feel better! 💧
hint: We fill a glass from the tap.

question: Who stays awake to guard the streets at night? 👮
explanation: Awesome! The brave police keep us safe while we sleep! 👮
hint: They drive cars with flashing lights.

question: What small light helps us read in bed? 📖
explanation: Great! A small lamp gives just enough light to read a book! 🛋️
hint: It sits on a table next to the bed.

question: What makes a dark shape on the wall at night? 🌑
explanation: Super! When light shines on us, it makes a fun shadow on the wall! 👤
hint: It copies your movements.

question: What green animal makes loud croaking sounds at night? 🐸
explanation: Awesome! Frogs like to sit near water and croak loudly at night! 🐸
hint: It jumps and says 'Ribbit'.

question: Where do our cars rest at night? 🚗
explanation: Great job! Cars stay safe and parked in the garage at night! 🚗
hint: It is like a room for cars.

question: Where does a tiny baby sleep? 👶
explanation: Super! A crib has tall sides to keep the baby safe while sleeping! 👶
hint: It is a special small bed.

question: When does night time come? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! When the sun sets in the evening, the night begins! 🌙
hint: It comes at the end of the day.

question: What tells us that the night is over? 🌄
explanation: Great! The beautiful sunrise means a new morning is here! ☀️
hint: The sun coming up.

question: How do we wake up after a very good sleep? 😃
explanation: Super! A good sleep gives us lots of energy to feel happy and fresh! 🌟
hint: We feel good and ready to play.

question: What is the very best thing about the night? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! The best thing about night is getting a peaceful rest! 😌
hint: Sleeping peacefully.

question: What covers our windows at night to keep it dark? 🪟
explanation: Great job! Curtains cover the windows to keep our room nice and dark! 🪟
hint: We pull them across the window.
